# tasks.feature_classification { #operetta_compose.tasks.feature_classification }

`tasks.feature_classification`



## Functions

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [feature_classification](#operetta_compose.tasks.feature_classification.feature_classification) | Classify cells with a trained classifier and write them to the OME-Zarr. |

### feature_classification { #operetta_compose.tasks.feature_classification.feature_classification }

```python
tasks.feature_classification.feature_classification(
    zarr_url,
    classifier_path,
    table_name='regionprops',
    classifier_name=None,
)
```

Classify cells with a trained classifier and write them to the OME-Zarr.

The classifier can be a full `.clf` file or a neutral joblib bundle
with following three keys
 - ``estimator``: the fitted scikit-learn model
 - ``feature_names``: the feature columns
 - ``class_names``: the human-readable label per class

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type        | Description                                                                                                                                           | Default         |
|-----------------|-------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------|
| zarr_url        | str         | Path to an OME-ZARR Image                                                                                                                             | _required_      |
| classifier_path | str         | Path to the joblib classifier bundle                                                                                                                  | _required_      |
| table_name      | str         | Folder name of the measured regionprops features                                                                                                      | `'regionprops'` |
| classifier_name | str \| None | Name of the classification results to be written to the feature table. It will default to the name of the classifier + "_prediction" when left unset. | `None`          |
